question: Who among the following wrote the book 'Chhaunk: On Food, Economics and Society'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhijit Banerjee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Abhijit Banerjee** is a renowned Indian economist who won the **Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences** in 2019, alongside Esther Duflo and Michael Kremer.
 
• He co-authored the book "**Chhaunk: On Food, Economics and Society**," which explores the intersection of food culture, economy, and societal issues.
 
• Banerjee is a professor of economics at the **Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)**.
 
• His work focuses on poverty alleviation and development economics, with significant contributions to experimental approaches in understanding economic issues.
 
• Abhijit Banerjee has also co-authored other notable books such as "**Poor Economics**" and "**Good Economics for Hard Times**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Experimental Economics**

 
 
• Abhijit Banerjee's work in experimental economics focuses on randomized controlled trials (RCTs) to test the effectiveness of policies on poverty alleviation.
 
• RCTs provide evidence-based insights into what works and what does not in addressing economic challenges.
 
 
 
• **Food Culture and Economics**
 
 
• Banerjee's book "**Chhaunk**" discusses how food habits are deeply influenced by economic conditions and societal structures.
 
• It provides a unique perspective on how food reflects cultural identity and economic disparities.
 
 
 
• **Global Recognition**
 
 
• Abhijit Banerjee's contributions have earned him international acclaim, including the **Nobel Prize** for his approach to addressing global poverty.
 
• He is considered one of the most influential economists of his time.
 
 
 
• **Collaborative Work**
 
 
• Banerjee frequently collaborates with Esther Duflo, his Nobel co-recipient and spouse, on research and writing projects.
 
• Their joint efforts aim to bridge the gap between economic theory and practical solutions to poverty.
